mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and drive positive equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS increasing and UNRATE decreasing fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding the 12-month average signals robust consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds the 12-month average during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend over the prior 3 months indicates manufacturing strength that correlates with positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% yoy.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand that drives positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes, a decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.0% during high unemployment regimes.
